stock.description: As an investment holding company, China Success Finance Group Holdings Limited provides a comprehensive suite of financial services throughout the People's Republic of China. These services encompass a broad range of guarantees, including those for corporate and individual credit, financial leasing equipment, trusteeship, joint and corporate bond issuance, non-financing, and performance, along with letters of guarantee for construction. The company also offers extensive asset management solutions, covering strategic investment and financing oversight, asset and debt restructuring, specialized asset acquisition, and corporate financial management advisory. Furthermore, it manages private equity funds, offers general asset management services, and provides expert investment advisory. Its financial leasing options include direct, trusted, and joint leasing arrangements, as well as sale-leaseback solutions and bank factoring. Additional specialized services include investment and acquisition facilitation, access to overseas capital, supply chain and real estate finance, micro-credit provision, and support for agricultural development. Founded in 1996, the company maintains its headquarters in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
